name: GJ 809
description: A nearby red dwarf, 55% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured by interferometry.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 809: radius in solar radii, 0.5472 +/- 0.0067, from this work (CHARA)

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 809: mass 0.573 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 809: effective temperature in K, 3692 +/- 22, from this work (CHARA)

text.card: A nearby red dwarf whose disc was measured by interferometry: 55% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Interferometry gives it 0.5472 solar radii; with its total light, that makes its surface 3,692 K.
